startupProfile.note: Measured locally through Wrangler alpha startup profiler; useful for relative startup analysis, not exact Cloudflare edge timing.

notes: `wrangler check startup --config worker/wrangler.toml` did not read the TOML entry point in this environment, so the successful check used a dry-run worker bundle.
The current `worker/wrangler.toml` compatibility_date is 2024-06-20; upgrading it should be handled as a deliberate runtime-compatibility task, not as an incidental verification change.
A generated bundle/profile scan matched only ordinary source-code identifiers and did not expose credential values.
